01 / Build capabilities

Custom Programs

Build a learning journey around the people who will put it into practice.

Start with your business priorities and the capabilities your people need. Together, we shape a program that connects relevant knowledge with the situations your teams face at work.

Learning can combine online and in-person sessions, experiential activities, business projects and coaching. The approach is designed around your audience, your context and the change you want to support.

Areas we can explore

  • Hospitality Management
  • Service Management
  • Human-Centric ManagementWorkplace well-being, cross-cultural leadership, managing disruption and leadership development.

Intended outcomeRelevant knowledge, practical skills and a clearer connection between learning and your organization’s priorities.

Learning in practice

CHUV / Healthcare

Hospitality skills for patient care.

EHL’s collaboration with CHUV brings hospitality principles into healthcare through tailored training. The published story explores how learning is adapted to patient interactions and the experience of healthcare professionals.

Read the published story ↗

02 / Think and align together

Management Workshops & Seminars

Make time for the conversations that move your team forward.

Give your management team room to step back from day-to-day demands, question assumptions and work on a shared priority. Facilitated sessions combine learning, discussion and collective exploration.

Explore ideation and innovation, build or revisit a business framework or Business Canvas, and reflect on strategic choices. Workshops can also focus on conflict management, team facilitation and alignment around a common direction.

Intended outcomeFresh perspectives, a shared understanding of the challenge and practical ideas your team can develop together.

03 / Explore new perspectives

Study Tours

Step into other environments. Bring a different perspective back.

Give your professional or academic group the opportunity to connect what they learn with what happens in practice. Educational journeys bring together academic perspectives, curated visits and conversations with industry professionals.

Explore how different organizations approach trends, innovation, talent management, leadership and customer experience. Immersive activities and exchanges with experts and thought leaders create space to ask questions and reflect on your own context.

Intended outcomeA broader perspective, concrete examples and ideas participants can relate to their own studies or professional practice.

Explore our methodology ↗
  1. 01

    Understand

    Start with your people and your goals.

    Explore your objectives, your participants and the context in which they will use what they learn.

  2. 02

    Shape

    Choose the right learning approach.

    Identify the themes and format that fit your needs, whether a custom program, a focused workshop or an immersive study tour.

  3. 03

    Design

    Make the experience relevant.

    Build a sequence of activities, discussions and experiences that connects the learning objectives with your participants’ context.

  4. 04

    Learn & Apply

    Connect insight with practice.

    Give participants opportunities to explore ideas, exchange perspectives and relate their learning to professional situations.

  5. 05

    Review

    Reflect on what comes next.

    Gather feedback, discuss the learning and identify opportunities to take it further.
